title: Hacker's Delight popcount (Fig. 5-2) computes the bit count
statement: Warren's five-step SWAR population count equals the 32-term bit-sum specification for every 32-bit word. This is the worked example in the Lean 4 reference manual (proved there by bv_decide) and the first identity in Bhat et al.'s 100%-of-Hacker's-Delight width-independent result; here it is decided by axeyum's front door.
sources: Bhat, Stefanesco, Hughes, Grosser, OOPSLA 2025, doi:10.1145/3763148
